title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Velus Jones Jr. released by Seahawks
items.desc: The Seahawks released RB Velus Jones Jr.
items.impact: Jones will figure to seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Irvin Charles (knee) activated from IR
items.desc: The Seahawks activated WR/Special teams ace Irv Charles from IR.
items.impact: Charles will figure to make an impact on special teams for Seattle.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Xavier Guillory released by Ravens
items.desc: The Ravens released WR Xavier Guillory.
items.impact: Guillory will figure to seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chris Moore released by Ravens
items.desc: The Ravens released WR Chris Moore.
items.impact: Baltimore is expected to get back rookie WR Ja'Kobi Lane soon. Moore loses his spot on the Ravens 53-man roster.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Montez Sweat suspended two games
items.desc: Bears DE Montez Sweat has been suspended for the next 2 games for violating the NFL's Performance-Enhancing Substances Policy.
items.impact: Sweat will miss Sunday at Atlanta and the following Thursday vs. New England.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaelan Phillips (hamstring) works off to side during practice Tuesday
items.desc: Jaelan Phillips was seen working off to the side during practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Phillips did have pads and a jersey on. It is the first practice out of the bye week for the Panthers. He is hopeful to return this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: AJ Dillon working off to side during practice Tuesday
items.desc: AJ Dillon was working off to the side during practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Dillon did have pads and a jersey on. It is the first practice out of the bye week for the Panthers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tommy Tremble not practicing Tuesday
items.desc: Tommy Tremble was not practicing on Tuesday.
items.impact: Tremble did not have his jersey on during practice to open the week off the Panthers bye. His status will need to be monitored in practice the next few days.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Monroe Freeling (knee) not practicing Tuesday
items.desc: Monroe Freeling was not practicing on Tuesday.
items.impact: Freeling did not have his jersey on during practice to open the week off the Panthers bye. His status will need to be monitored in practice the next few days.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cam Jackson (shoulder) to undergo season-ending surgery
items.desc: Panthers coach Dave Canales said Cam Jackson is set for season-ending shoulder surgery.
items.impact: It is not related to the knee surgery Jackson suffered in Week 4. He will miss the rest of the season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Pharaoh Brown signs with Colts 53-man roster
items.desc: The Colts signed TE Pharaoh Brown to the 53-man roster from the practice squad.
items.impact: Brown will add depth in the Colts tight end room.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Damien Lewis (elbow) at practice Tuesday
items.desc: Panthers OL Damien Lewis was at practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Lewis is working his way back from an ankle injury. His status will need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Germaine Pratt re-signs with Colts
items.desc: Veteran LB Germaine Pratt has re-signed with Colts.
items.impact: Pratt will join the Colts practice squad.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ladd McConkey (foot) 'working back this week'
items.desc: Chargers coach Jim Harbaugh said that Ladd McConkey is "working back in this week."
items.impact: McConkey was active this past week, but he did not see the field. His status will need to be monitored the rest of this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Quentin Johnston (chest) expected to be limited in practice
items.desc: Chargers coach Jim Harbaugh said Quentin Johnston will "probably be limited this week like last for the practice."
items.impact: "We'll see where he's at the end of the week," Harbaugh said. Johnston will have a chance to return in Week 6.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tre' Harris (hamstring) considered week-to-week
items.desc: Chargers coach Jim Harbaugh said Tre' Harris is "more of a week-to-week [thing]."
items.impact: Harris will likely be targeting a return in Week 8 following the Chargers bye.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Joe Alt (neck) to visit specialist
items.desc: Chargers coach Jim Harbaugh said OT Joe Alt will see a specialist.
items.impact: Alt remains week-to-week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jauan Jennings: 49ers team to monitor
items.desc: NFL Network's Ian Rapoport reports Jauan Jennings "would be a name for me to keep an eye on" for the 49ers.
items.impact: Jennings has been disappointing to start the season with the Vikings. A reunion with the 49ers could be a possibility as their wide receiver room remains banged up.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Emari Demercado expected to re-sign with Cowboys
items.desc: The Cowboys are expected to re-sign RB Emari Demercado.
items.impact: Demercado had been competing with Tyler Goodson for the backup role. He will remain off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jalen Coker (quad) remains on track to return in Week 6
items.desc: Panthers coach Dave Canales said Jalen Coker is "on track" to play in Carolina's Week 6 game against the Eagles.
items.impact: This confirms a previous report from Monday. He was spotted practicing on Tuesday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jerry Jeudy could be traded by Browns
items.desc: The Browns are reportedly seeking a third or fourth-round pick for WR Jerry Jeudy.
items.impact: Jordan Schultz reported he's not sure they'll be able to get it. Jeudy will be a player to monitor closer to the trade deadline.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Blake Grupe signed by Rams
items.desc: The Rams signed kicker Blake Grupe off the Jets practice squad.
items.impact: Grupe will get an opportunity with the Rams with Harrison Mevis released.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Harrison Mevis released by Rams
items.desc: The Rams released kicker Harrison Mevis.
items.impact: Mevis missed two field goals in Monday's loss against the Bills. The Rams signed Blake Grupe off the Jets practice squad as the corresponding move.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Trevor Etienne (ankle) has practice window opened
items.desc: The Panthers have opened the practice window for Trevor Etienne.
items.impact: Etienne missed the start of the season due to an ankle injury he suffered in the preseason. He will have 21 days to officially be activated by Carolina.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tershawn Wharton (neck) has practice window opened
items.desc: The Panthers have opened the practice window for Tershawn Wharton.
items.impact: Wharton missed the start of the season due to a neck injury. He will have 21 days to officially be activated by Carolina.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Taylor Moton (blood clot) has practice window opened
items.desc: The Panthers have opened the practice window for Taylor Moton.
items.impact: Moton missed the start of the season due to a blood clot. He will have 21 days to officially be activated by Carolina.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Will Campbell (knee) considered week-to-week
items.desc: Patriots LT Will Campbell avoided a major knee injury Sunday and is considered week-to-week.
items.impact: It is positive news for Campbell and the Patriots. He will likely miss at least one game, but he shouldn't miss too much time.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cam Gill released by Panthers
items.desc: The Panthers released LB Cam Gill.
items.impact: Gill will figure to seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Robert Rochell signs with Panthers
items.desc: The Panthers signed CB Robert Rochell.
items.impact: Rochell was with Carolina last year and earlier this season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jalyx Hunt (knee/ankle) unlikely to play in Week 6
items.desc: Eagles defensive coordinator Vic Fangio said that it would be "miraculous" if Jalyx Hunt is able to play against the Panthers in Week 6.
items.impact: Hunt left last Sunday's game with knee and ankle injuries. He is likely to miss at least one game.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Kaevon Merriweather joins Jaguars roster
items.desc: Kaevon Merriweather has been signed from the practice squad to the Jaguars' active roster.
items.impact: Merriweather saw in-game action for the first time this season in the Jaguars' Week 5 win over the Eagles. The veteran defensive back played in his familiar special-teams role and saw about a third of the snaps on defense with safety Eric Murray (concussion) sidelined.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Devin Neal signs with Commanders
items.desc: Devin Neal has signed with the Commanders.
items.impact: Neal will initially join Washington's practice squad to provide depth at running back. The second-year pro was released by the Vikings last week. After being selected in the sixth round of last year's NFL Draft, Neal played in 10 games for the Saints last season, rushing for over 200 yards and a couple of touchdowns on 57 carries. He also displayed pass-catching ability, securing 17 of 19 targets for 104 yards.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) to miss multiple weeks
items.desc: TreVeyon Henderson will miss multiple weeks due to a high-ankle sprain.
items.impact: Henderson left Sunday's game early and was reevaluated Monday. On a positive note, the young running back will not require surgery, but he is going to miss some games. Veteran Rhamondre Stevenson will take over as the ball carrier in Henderson's absence.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Tanner Hudson (pectoral) to miss rest of the season
items.desc: Tanner Hudson (pectoral) will miss the rest of the season.
items.impact: After hauling in his first touchdown pass of the campaign in Week 5, Hudson is dealing with a torn pectoral that will force him out for the remainder of the season. Erick All Jr. saw an uptick in snaps after Hudson left Sunday's game.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Rams D/ST allows 37 points in OT loss
items.desc: The Rams D/ST allowed 37 points while notching one sack and forcing two turnovers in a 37-34 overtime loss to the Bills in Week 5.
items.impact: Los Angeles had a tough time slowing the Bills offense, especially on the ground as Buffalo racked up 234 rushing yards. The Rams did recover a James Cook fumble in overtime. The Rams will look to bounce back against the Cardinals in Week 6.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Tyler Higbee goes for 83 yards in Week 5
items.desc: Tyler Higbee caught five of his six targets for 83 yards in a 37-34 overtime loss to the Bills in Week 5.
items.impact: Higbee finished second on the Rams in receiving on Monday night, behind only Puka Nacua. The veteran tight end has earned a larger role in the team's offense thanks to some injuries in the LA tight-end room, having caught 18 passes for 212 yards and a touchdown over his past three contests. Higbee is looking like a solid fantasy option heading into Week 6 vs. Arizona.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Davante Adams brings in two TD passes in Week 5
items.desc: Davante Adams caught five of his seven targets for 51 yards and two touchdowns in a 37-34 overtime loss to the Bills in Week 5.
items.impact: Adams found the end zone twice in the high-scoring loss on Monday night. He kicked off the scoring for LA with a four-yard grab in the second quarter and later came back to add a five-yard catch for a score. Adams now has 27 catches for 441 yards and four touchdowns through five games for the Rams. He will be a solid WR2 in Week 6 vs. the Cardinals.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Puka Nacua draws 24 targets in Week 5 loss
items.desc: Puka Nacua caught 17 of his 24 targets for 138 yards and a touchdown while rushing twice for nine yards in a 37-34 overtime loss to the Bills in Week 5.
items.impact: Nacua drew an insane 24 targets, putting him third all-time in a single game in the NFL behind only Brandon Marshall (28) and Chris Chambers (26). The veteran wideout also found the end zone on a two-yard pass from Matthew Stafford in the fourth quarter. Nacua now has 31 catches for 337 yards and one touchdown in just three games this season. He will be a top-three fantasy WR in Week 6 vs. the Cardinals.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Blake Corum finds the end zone in Week 5
items.desc: Blake Corum carried the ball five times for 19 yards and a touchdown while catching three of his four targets for 53 yards in a 37-34 overtime loss to the Bills in Week 5.
items.impact: While still playing behind starter Kyren Williams, Corum turned in his most productive game of the year in the Monday night loss. He found the end zone for his first touchdown of the season on a one-yard run in the third quarter. Corum will remain a top fantasy handcuff behind Williams, but he is still just a low-end flex option in Week 6 vs. the Cardinals.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Kyren Williams finds the end zone in Week 5
items.desc: Kyren Williams carried the ball 16 times for 49 yards and a touchdown while catching six of his eight targets for 27 yards in a 37-34 overtime loss to the Bills in Week 5.
items.impact: Williams was mostly bottled up on the ground by the Buffalo defense on Monday night, but he still managed to punch in a one-yard TD run in the fourth quarter. The Rams' newfound willingness to use Williams in the passing attack this year has been an added bonus as he already has 27 catches through five games, putting him just nine grabs shy of setting a new career-high. Williams will be a locked-in RB1 in fantasy in Week 6 vs. the Cardinals.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Matthew Stafford throws three TDs in Week 5 loss
items.desc: Matthew Stafford completed 40 of his 54 pass attempts for 383 yards and three touchdowns in a 37-34 overtime loss to the Bills in Week 5.
items.impact: Stafford turned in a huge game in the Monday night loss to Buffalo, but he couldn't put any points on the board in overtime. The veteran quarterback threw two touchdown passes to Davante Adams, while his third went to Puka Nacua. Stafford has now thrown for 1,572 yards, nine touchdowns, and six interceptions through five games. He will be a solid QB1 in fantasy in Week 6 vs. the Cardinals.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Bills D/ST allows 34 points in OT win in Week 5
items.desc: The Bills D/ST allowed 34 points while picking up one sack in a 37-34 overtime win over the Rams in Week 5's Monday night game.
items.impact: Buffalo's defense struggled to slow the Rams in the game, although they toughened up in overtime, holding LA scoreless. The Bills will look for a better fantasy performance in Week 6 vs. the Raiders.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Tyler Bass wins it in OT for Bills in Week 5
items.desc: Tyler Bass made all three of his field-goal attempts and hit two of his three extra points in a 37-34 overtime win over the Rams in Week 5.
items.impact: Bass hit field goals from 49, 23, and 45 yards out in the win. His 45-yard attempt won the game for the Bills with two minutes left in overtime. Bass has now hit all 10 of his field-goal attempts this season. He will take on the Raiders in Week 6.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Dawson Knox hauls in one pass in Week 5
items.desc: Dawson Knox caught one of his three targets for a six-yard gain in a 37-34 overtime win over the Rams in Week 5's Monday night game.
items.impact: Knox turned in another slow day as he has yet to go over two catches or 13 receiving yards in a game thus far. Overall, the veteran tight end has seven catches for 36 yards and a touchdown through five games. He will not be a strong fantasy option in Week 6 vs. the Raiders.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Dalton Kincaid catches one pass in Week 5
items.desc: Dalton Kincaid caught one of his two targets for a seven-yard gain and added a two-point conversion catch in a 37-34 overtime win over the Rams in Week 5.
items.impact: Kincaid was quiet on Monday night, his second straight slow outing. After starting the season hot, Kincaid has just two catches for 14 yards over his past two contests. Overall, the veteran tight end has 16 catches for 277 yards and one touchdown through five games. He will be a low-end TE1 in Week 6 against the Raiders.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Khalil Shakir goes for 80 yards in Week 5 win
items.desc: Khalil Shakir caught all three of his targets for 80 yards in a 37-34 overtime win over the Rams in Week 5's Monday night game.
items.impact: Shakir led the Bills in receiving, doing most of his damage on a 57-yard catch early in overtime. Shakir now has 18 catches for 256 yards and no touchdowns through his team's first five games. He will be a flex option in fantasy heading into Week 6 vs. the Raiders.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Keon Coleman catches TD in Week 5
items.desc: Keon Coleman caught one of his two targets for a seven-yard touchdown in a 37-34 overtime win over the Rams in Week 5's Monday night game.
items.impact: Coleman made his only catch count as he hauled in Josh Allen's lone touchdown pass late in the third quarter. It was still a disappointing game for Coleman, who was expected to see a larger target share with DJ Moore (shoulder) inactive. Coleman will be on the flex radar in fantasy in Week 6 vs. the Raiders if Moore isn't ready to return to the field.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Ty Johnson goes for 72 receiving yards in Week 5
items.desc: Ty Johnson caught all four of his targets for 72 yards in a 37-34 overtime win over the Rams in Week 5's Monday night game.
items.impact: Johnson didn't see a carry in the contest but he finished second on the Bills in receiving yards in the exciting win. The veteran running back continues to be a threat in the passing attack as this was his second game this season with at least 50 receiving yards. Johnson will now prepare to take on the Raiders in Week 6.
